description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of queries used during inference and MRR@10 for different query selection methods in dense retrieval. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 10, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" with a linear scale, ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, and tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The plot displays six lines representing different query selection methods: DPR w/o query (black, solid line), DPR w/ gold (yellow, solid line with diamond markers), DPR w/ top-1 (green, solid line with circle markers), DPR w/ bottom-1 (purple, solid line with circle markers), DPR w/ random (blue, solid line with circle markers), and DPR w/ curriculum (red, solid line with circle markers). The black line remains steady at approximately 34.5 across the x-axis. The yellow line starts below 33.0 at x=1, increases to around 34.9 at x=8, and reaches 35.0 at x=10. The green line begins below 33.0 at x=1, sharply increases to around 35.5 at x=4, continues to rise to approximately 36.3 at x=8, and reaches 36.5 at x=10. The purple line starts at around 35.0 at x=1, decreases to approximately 34.7 at x=4, and remains relatively stable until x=10. The blue line begins at around 35.0 at x=1, increases to approximately 35.5 at x=4, and remains relatively stable until x=10. The red line starts at around 35.4 at x=1, increases to approximately 35.7 at x=4, and remains relatively stable until x=10.
